statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail remains below the block threshold during post-PMI and state-labor price discovery.
recommendation: Current evidence maps to WATCH: the Nasdaq opened higher and services activity surprised strongly, while elevated yields, oil and geopolitical risk keep the opening hour unusually sensitive.
headline: WATCH: strong U.S. services PMI meets higher Nasdaq opening and persistent rates/oil stress
body: The Nasdaq Composite opened 0.51% higher. Flash U.S. services PMI rose to 56.8 and the composite index to 56.0, while manufacturing eased to 53.2. The growth surprise raises rates-sensitive event risk, but no fresh independent evidence yet confirms persistent extension with shallow or failed retracements. State labor results were not independently verified at the cutoff.
